project.name: AspiraPath AI
project.type: Generative AI Career and Education Guidance Platform

problem_statement.title: Bridging Career Aspiration and Achievable Action
problem_statement.description: Students often know what career they want but lack clarity about qualifications, skills, courses, certifications, projects, costs, study time, location requirements and practical next steps.
problem_statement.key_problem: Generic career guidance often does not consider an individual student's academic profile, skills, budget, time and geographic constraints.

proposed_solution.description: AspiraPath AI uses Generative AI to analyze a student's profile, career aspiration and constraints and generate a personalized education and career pathway.
